metadata.topic: Electricity — Ohm's Law: Resistance from Voltage and Current
metadata.note: Circuit diagram (Figure 9) shows 12V DC battery connected to a variable resistor and coil with an ammeter reading 1.5A when the switch is closed. R = V/I = 12/1.5 = 8Ω. Marks: 1m formula, 1m substitution, 1m correct answer.

question.name: CSEC Phy Jun 2023 Q5b(iv) — Ohm's Law: Circuit Resistance
question.text:
A circuit contains a 12 V DC battery connected in series with a variable resistor, an electromagnet coil, an ammeter, and a switch (Figure 9).

When the switch is closed, the reading on the ammeter is 1.5 A.

Calculate the resistance of the circuit. (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Model solution:
Ohm's Law: V = IR → R = V / I
R = 12 / 1.5 = 8 Ω

steps.label:
Given: Voltage V = 12 V  |  Current I = 1.5 A
Ohm's Law: V = IR → R = V / I
Apply Ohm's Law to calculate the resistance R of the circuit. (3 marks)

fields.label: Formula used: R = _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Ohm's Law: V = IR, rearranged to R = V/I

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Use Ohm's Law: V = IR. Rearrange for R: R = V / I.
R = V / I. Do not use R = I / V (that would give 0.125, not 8).
